about_the_game:
In this world, deadly toxic mist is everywhere. The protagonist, Yaqing, becomes an apprentice to a physician skilled in using insects to save his sister, who has been poisoned by the mist. As the story progresses, he finds himself entangled in a tense racial conflict…

–
An adventure puzzle RPG set in a fictional world featuring an intrincate story with rich characters and over 350,000 words of text. There are three main story endings and over 20 side endings, with professional voice acting for the primary dialogues.

Explore and Gather, Save Your Loved Ones


In this world, dangerous toxic mist abounds, and entering it means almost certain death. To save his sister, who has fallen into a coma from the mist's poison, Yaqing travels to a city called ’Hidden Town’ and becomes an apprentice to a physician skilled in using insects. He begins learning how to catch insects and gather materials, creating medicinal vessels to cure his sister.

Human Joys and Sorrows, Multiple Endings


Yaqing must explore various locations and interact with over 120 NPCs, experiencing the joys and sorrows of different families and even deciding their fates. By increasing his favorability with NPCs, he will learn various rumors and, through a deep web of narratives, gain a deeper understanding of the people, triggering different plots and obtaining character gacha.

Racial Conflicts on the Brink


As the story progresses, Yaqing uncovers a long-standing conflict between two races, hidden beneath the facade of peace. This impending dispute threatens to bring catastrophe to the inhabitants. Unknowingly, Yaqing and his sister are drawn into this vortex as well...
